outcome: Experiment Authoring now has a real syntax-highlighted code editor foundation
owner_impact: Configuration, Initialization, Controller and Metrics are edited through a CodeMirror surface with line numbers, Python-like syntax highlighting, normal selection/undo/redo/clipboard behavior and preserved responsive styling. The existing artifact textareas remain the authoritative source buffers underneath, so dirty-state, autosave, Apply & restart, revision history and read-only Experiment behavior keep their established semantics.

next.text: #204 is the next code-authoring ergonomics ticket. It adds parser-derived outline/symbol navigation, folding and reliable in-artifact search on top of this editor foundation. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: CodeMirror uses the public codemirror meta-package API plus the Python language extension; unsupported direct state/view APIs are not used.
Configuration, Initialization, Controller and Metrics receive CodeMirror line numbers, history/selection editing behavior and Python syntax highlighting where their artifact format is Python-like.
CodeMirror edits mirror into the authoritative textareas through the existing input contract, while authoritative Experiment/revision loads replace editor content without manufacturing dirty edits.
Read-only state is enforced by rebuilding the CodeMirror surface with EditorView.editable disabled while the authoritative textarea remains read-only.
The existing interaction-boundary autosave logic treats the CodeMirror surface as inside the artifact editor.

Production browser smoke requires four ready CodeMirror surfaces, hidden authoritative fallback textareas, line numbers and rendered highlighted tokens, and reports exact editor initialization errors.
